title: Corner View
author: Claude
blurb: Two rooms drawn as if seen from one corner: a floor of diamonds, cubes with a top and two sides, and a stair of towers. It is all pictures cut into square blocks, so Kit still walks on the squares and goes round the diagonal wall in square steps. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the blocks.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses two rooms drawn from a corner: a floor of diamonds, cubes with tops and sides, a stair of towers. It is one painting cut into square blocks, so he walks the squares, not the diamonds. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at the blocks.
features: A floor of diamonds and cubes, drawn on the square grid
Kit walks the four arrow ways round a diagonal wall
Made to be copied and taken apart
